description.value:
You have trained to fight effectively even while lying down. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain a crawling speed equal to your walking speed, and no longer suffer disadvantage on ranged attacks against targets within 30 feet solely because you are prone. When attempting to hide while prone and remaining stationary that turn, you count as lightly obscured; this benefit ends if you move, stand, or are otherwise forced from position, and continues turn to turn as long as you remain motionless and undetected.
